Card Q&A.a: It prevents the opponent's Digimon that was suspended by this effect from unsuspending.
Card Q&A.q: Which Digimon does this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect prevent from unsuspending in the next unsuspend phase, this Digimon or the opponent's Digimon that was suspended by this effect?

Card Q&A.a: No, even if this effect couldn't suspend a Digimon, it can still give it "can't unsuspend."
Card Q&A.q: If this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect couldn't suspend a Digimon, does that mean it can't give that Digimon "can't unsuspend"?

Effect: ＜Training＞ (In the main phase, by suspending this Digimon, place your deck's top card face down as this Digimon's bottom digivolution card. This effect can also activate in the breeding area.)

[On Play] [When Digivolving] By placing 1 card in your hand face down as this Digimon's bottom digivolution card, suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon. It can't unsuspend in their next unsuspend phase.
Inherited Effect: [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] Suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon.
